name: Pharon
description: A dying Kjeldoran wizard who reveals the Blare of Doom spell.

description_citations.text: "The Secrets of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Scribe Barrinalo records Pharon's dying words, leaves Kjeld and adopts the name Barrin when ink runs while signing out.
timeline.quote: he adopted the name "Barrin" in recognition of his new life

citation.text: "Barrin", section "Barrinalo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pharon reveals the Blare of Doom to scribe Barrinalo and names him successor.
timeline.quote: He also names the scribe his successor.

citation.text: "The Secrets of Magic", section "For Want of Ink , by Paul B. Thompson". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A dying wizard who taught Barrinalo the Blare of Doom and told him to become the most powerful wizard.
